audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gwen Levels 2-3 and 2+ items, while the prose says 'Sylas owns this' at 2, 'He edges 4-5', and calls the late game a coinflip.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Sylas/Skill/Sylas/Gwen/Gwen/Skill and matches the prose exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text; Hijack's ramping cooldown was never quantified.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s — at rank 3 he can steal Needlework every 30 seconds, which is what keeps the late game even.
audit.corrected: Hijack's 30s rank-3 cooldown written into the Level 6 and 2+ item rows and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers call Abscond/Abduct a 'dash + stun' in five places, and neither mentions that Kingslayer heals off champions.
audit.why: Riot on Abscond: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — the recast is a self-pull, and the kit's derived flags list only projectile and dash, no hard CC. Riot on Kingslayer: 'lunges at an enemy... dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions', which is why _missing-interactions.json flags this matchup for Grievous Wounds. Both Abscond and Kingslayer are 400 range, so from outside Hallowed Mist neither can reach her.
audit.corrected: Recast-pull phrasing replaces the stun claim; Grievous Wounds and the 400-range Mist denial written in.

audit.why: Abscond 13/12/11/10/9s, Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, Chain Lash 10/9/8/7/6s with a delayed second detonation at the intersection.
audit.corrected: Written into the cooldown block and trading rules.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Sylas contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both soft at 1. Chain Lash intersects at 775 and explodes a beat later — step off the crossing point and the second half does nothing.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Sylas's Abscond / Abduct is down.
edits.after: Sylas owns 2: Abscond closes 400 and the recast chains him back onto you, then Kingslayer heals the trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sylas must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash gives you a reset, but Kingslayer's heal trades level with your passive sustain until Mist arrives.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abscond / Abduct's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He edges 4-5. Kingslayer is 7.5s at rank 4 and heals off champions — bring Grievous Wounds before you try to win a long trade.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Mist flips it: Abscond and Kingslayer are both 400 range, so from outside the fog neither can reach you. Bait Hijack before you ult.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Abscond / Abduct's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — your %-max-HP snips out-grind a burst-and-Kingslayer pattern.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two even AP scalers late. Hijack is only 30s at rank 3, so never open a fight with Needlework — make him spend R first.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond (9-13s): he dashes 400, then recasts to chain himself back onto you. Bait it, then commit. - Kingslayer (6-12s): heals off champions, so Grievous Wounds is mandatory. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sylas with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Sylas wastes Abscond / Abduct — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Sylas with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Abscond is spent and he cannot chain onto you for 9-13s — commit the full pattern. Bad trade: standing on Chain Lash's intersection point, where the delayed detonation doubles the poke.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Abscond dashes 400 and recasts to chain him onto you; Kingslayer heals off champions, so Grievous Wounds decides long trades.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — shred him with %HP snips from inside the mist.
edits.after: Bait his Abscond recast, then snip him down from inside the mist.

edits.before: Sylas is a real AP lane bully before you spike — his Abscond-Abduct (E) closes the gap and his Chain Lash (Q) pokes you, while Kingslayer (W) heals the trade back, and you have no Hallowed Mist yet to make yourself untargetable. Do not walk up to throw a cone Q he can answer with his E dash-stun and W heal-trade. Farm with the tip of Snip Snip!, soak a little poke, and respect that his W execute-heal swings short trades his way — your sustain only out-grinds his once you have your full kit.
edits.after: Sylas is a real AP lane bully before you spike — his Abscond (E) closes 400 and the recast chains him back onto you, his Chain Lash (Q) pokes from 775, and Kingslayer (W) heals the trade back, while you have no Hallowed Mist yet. Do not walk up to throw a cone Q he can answer with the recast and a W heal-trade. Farm with the tip of Snip Snip!, soak a little poke, and respect that his W heals off champions — your sustain only out-grinds his once you own your full kit and Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Level 6 is your flip. When he commits Abduct (E) into you, drop Hallowed Mist right as the stun lands so he is standing inside the cloud and you go untargetable while you keep snipping, then slow him with Needlework so the dash cannot kite back out. The one trap: his R Hijacks your Needlework, so do not open with your ult in a fight you can win without it — bait the R, then commit.
edits.after: Level 6 is your flip. When he commits Abscond (E) and recasts onto you, drop Hallowed Mist as he arrives so he is standing inside the cloud and you go untargetable while you keep snipping, then slow him with Needlework so the dash cannot kite back out. The one trap: Hijack is only 30 seconds at rank 3, so never open with your ult in a fight you can win without it — bait the R, then commit.

edits.before: Needlework plus mist flips it — go untargetable on his Abduct, slow him with R, and your passive healing out-sustains his Kingslayer.
edits.after: Needlework plus mist flips it — Abscond and Kingslayer are both 400 range, so from outside the fog neither reaches you while you keep snipping.

notes: Riot's Abscond text describes only a dash plus a self-pull recast; the kit's derived flags carry no hard CC, yet both layers called it a stun in five places. I rewrote it to what Riot states rather than asserting the stun does not exist — flagged as unverified. Kingslayer's champion-only heal (the Grievous Wounds trigger from _missing-interactions.json) was absent from both layers.
